message.content:
An editorial illustration shows several people standing on a red and orange checkered floor, which transitions to a solid white background towards the top. A large orange word "TEMPO" is positioned at the upper center, with the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" written underneath in smaller black letters. 

At the top left, a person in a red and black outfit holds a large yellow rectangle. In the top middle, a person in a white uniform holds a red rectangle. On the far left, a person in a white shirt and black pants gestures with open hands. Beside them, a person in a red-and-black plaid shirt stands with their back turned. On the right, a person in black clothing stands facing the others. At the bottom right, a person in a blue shirt crouches and holds a rectangular floor tile, appearing to lift it from the ground.

Text at the top reads: "MOTIF GRASI ANTASARI / CALON DIREKTUR UTAMA PERTAMINA". Large black text at the bottom right reads: "MANUVER TERAKHIR". Additional text below states: "YUDHOYONO, MEGAWATI, DAN PRABOWO TURUN GUNUNG DALAM PEMILIHAN GUBERNUR JAKARTA. JALAN MENUJU PEMILU PRESIDEN 2019." A barcode and date "13-19 FEBRUARI 2017" are at the bottom left.
